profile.name: Ronald Senokoane
profile.headline: Junior Full-Stack Software Developer
profile.summary: Junior Full-Stack Software Developer in South Africa, combining practical web application work with hands-on workplace IT support and administration. Brings a customer-focused perspective shaped by experience in banking and financial services, and is currently studying software development.
about: My path into software development has been shaped by solving practical problems for people. In banking and financial-services roles, I learned to listen carefully, work accurately with sensitive information, and support customers through important decisions.

At Tech Performance Center, my work combines administrative support with hands-on IT troubleshooting, software installation, and student-record administration. Alongside that experience, I am studying software development and building web applications with JavaScript, Node.js, and Firebase.
I am looking for a junior software engineering opportunity where I can keep learning, contribute dependable work, and build useful products with a collaborative team.

projects.title: TPC Student Register Management System
projects.status: Reported in use at Tech Performance Center
projects.description: A student-registration and record-management application used in a real training-centre setting.
projects.context: Student registration and records need an accessible, central place in the day-to-day work of a training centre.
projects.role: Workplace project associated with Tech Performance Center. Individual feature authorship and feature-level testing scope are not fully documented.
projects.solution: A browser-based register built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore in its stack.
projects.architecture: Web client → Firebase Authentication → Cloud Firestore; Firebase Hosting is used for delivery.
projects.security: The project information identifies Firebase Authentication and Firestore rules as part of the security approach. Rule effectiveness has not been independently audited here.
projects.testing: Feature-level independent test results were not provided; no claim is made that every listed feature has been independently tested.
projects.outcome: The register is reported to be in current use at Tech Performance Center. No usage totals or measured impact are claimed.
challenges: Supporting reliable student-record workflows in an operational training-centre context.
Keeping record access aligned with the intended user roles.
future: Document and test the complete attendance and access-control flows.
Review Firestore rules against the centre's confirmed role requirements.
evidence: The project and current-use status are described by the project owner.

projects.title: DevBlog — Developer Publishing Platform
projects.description: A full-stack publishing platform for authors to create, manage, and share developer articles.
projects.context: Developers need a straightforward way to publish articles and manage their own content.
projects.role: Primary repository contributor; Git history identifies Ronald Senokoane as the author of the repository's initial and subsequent commits.
projects.solution: A React and Vite frontend communicates with an Express API backed by MongoDB and Mongoose. JWT authentication protects author actions.
projects.architecture: React + Vite client → Express REST API → MongoDB/Mongoose; optional image uploads integrate with Multer and Cloudinary.
features: Article creation, reading, updating, and deletion
Protected author endpoints and article ownership checks
projects.security: The project documents JWT-protected author actions and ownership checks. Authentication uses bcryptjs according to the supplied project stack.
projects.testing: No comprehensive test results were provided for this portfolio. Features are described from the available project documentation and repository history.
projects.deployment: Frontend and backend demos are hosted on Render.
projects.outcome: A deployed full-stack demonstration is available. No usage or performance metrics are claimed.
challenges: Keeping author-only actions protected across the frontend and API.
Connecting optional image uploads to a third-party media service.
future: Verify and document the production Cloudinary configuration before presenting image uploads as operational.
Add repeatable automated tests for protected routes and article ownership.
evidence: README and repository history describe a React/Vite frontend and Express/MongoDB backend.
The supplied project notes report earlier production Cloudinary credential errors; whether they are resolved has not been verified.
